business_problem: Repsol found that everyday knowledge-work tasks such as summarizing content, pulling key information, and managing emails were consuming time that employees could otherwise spend on higher-value strategic work, so it wanted to improve productivity and work quality with new AI-enabled ways of working.
solution_summary: Repsol worked with Accenture, Microsoft, and Avanade to deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot across the organization through an early access program and validate the rollout with a 550-person pilot. The implementation focused on day-to-day information work rather than a standalone AI app: employees record meetings, then use Microsoft 365 Copilot to extract tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities from that meeting content. Users continue the workflow in Word, where prompts turn notes into structured summaries, and then generate presentation drafts in PowerPoint. Finance teams also use Copilot to analyze RFP responses and create RFP content from scratch. The source does not describe a separate storage or model-hosting layer; artifacts remain embedded in Microsoft 365 work products such as meeting notes, summaries, presentations, emails, and RFP documents, with training, support, incident handling, and change management wrapped around the deployment.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
solution_components.role: Generative AI assistant used to extract tasks from meetings, summarize content, support email work, and help finance teams analyze or draft RFP materials.

solution_components.name: Word
solution_components.role: Authoring surface where employees prompt Copilot to turn meeting notes into clear written summaries.

solution_components.name: PowerPoint
solution_components.role: Presentation surface used to turn Copilot-assisted summaries into draft slide decks.

data_flow: Employees capture meeting content and other work materials such as emails and RFP responses, then Microsoft 365 Copilot extracts key tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities. Those outputs are refined in Word into summaries and turned into PowerPoint drafts, while finance teams use the same Copilot-assisted workflow to analyze incoming RFP responses or generate new proposal content.
integration_points: Request for Proposal (RFP) documents and responses
business_outcome: Repsol reported measurable productivity and quality gains from the pilot, along with stronger employee adoption, improved confidence and creativity, and a planned expansion from the pilot to enterprise-wide deployment.
